JSON.stringify(function(){var ts=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#gxStage text'));var hits=[];for(var a=0;a<ts.length;a++){for(var b=a+1;b<ts.length;b++){var A=ts[a].getBBox(),B=ts[b].getBBox();var ix=Math.min(A.x+A.width,B.x+B.width)-Math.max(A.x,B.x);var iy=Math.min(A.y+A.height,B.y+B.height)-Math.max(A.y,B.y);if(ix>3&&iy>3){hits.push([ts[a].textContent,ts[b].textContent])}}}return hits}())
